svg.text: Why p(1 − p) plays the role of σ²
Code yes = 1 and no = 0. Then p̂ is just the average of the 0s and 1s, and their variance is E[X²] − (E[X])² = p − p² = p(1 − p).
Below: the dots at 0 and 1 are the 20 single answers; the curve is where their average p̂ lands across many surveys of n = 100.
